$comment: Machine-readable lifecycle thresholds. Source of truth: packages/dsh-stream-state/src/tables.ts. This projection is what the Swift mirror (swift/CarrierDecision.swift) reads, and what scripts/gates/verify-ladder-table-parity.mjs locks the surviving module constants of the carrier decisions and the four recovery ladders to (B4/G-G), and checks that every named consumer reads the table instead of owning a copy. The package suite fails if the two disagree (test/tables/tables-parity.test.ts) and scripts/gates/verify-stream-state-swift-parity.mjs fails if the mirror disagrees.

deliveryEfficacy.resets: the physical socket and every logical window on it
deliveryEfficacy.evidence: zero-frame socket or a stalled live tail
open state is loading with no open in flight, or an error the header cannot heal, and no resync disposing

deliveryEfficacy.evidence: that instance is stalled while the document frame counter still advances

deliveryEfficacy.resets: module-level state and the whole JS context
deliveryEfficacy.evidence: the document frame counter is stalled
